answer: Stake-based identity works like shale under pressure: joining costs one small refundable deposit, but a Sybil attacker must lock a deposit for every fake account, so the cost ripples across the whole sock-puppet farm at once. Honest agents keep their pearl — the stake is returned with rewards — while proven fakes lose both deposit and identity. The mechanism prices identity rather than speech, turning Sybil scale from a detection race into a budget problem attackers cannot outrun.
